checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess
cli='/Users/HUAWEI/.highgrade/global/releases/v0-4-1/highgrade'
for path in [Path('.highgrade/project/documents.json'),Path('.highgrade/project/survey.json'),*Path('specs').rglob('*.json')]: json.loads(path.read_text())
assert 'mass-import source history, invent tags or convert proposals into accepted requirements' in Path('.highgrade/project/INSTRUCTIONS.md').read_text()
tags=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([cli,'spec-tags','--root','.'],text=True))['result']['tags']
change=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([cli,'spec-read','--root','.','--id','HG-0001','--view','editable'],text=True))['result']['value']
assert tags=={}, tags
assert change.get('tags',[])==[], change.get('tags')
print('All project/specification JSON parsed; original tag restriction restored; tag vocabulary and assignment are empty.')
PY
